Package Model

Class Enrollment

java.lang.Object
Model.Entity
Model.Enrollment
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.os.Parcelable
public class Enrollment extends Entity
Represents a client's enrollment in a course, with timestamp. Extends Entity to inherit a unique ID.
